title: Screen juniors on what they can do, not on their resume
takeaway: Replace the resume filter with one short, identical, auto-scored round, then judge projects by the decisions behind them.
sources: The result is a funnel that looks rigorous and selects for background.
Instead of reading 400 resumes, send every applicant the same short first round:
For the candidates who clear the first round, projects are the best evidence a junior has.
A process that takes a month loses the best of them to the one that takes a week.

stages.label: Every applicant, no resume filter
stages.note: the same 20 to 30 minute round, auto-scored

stages.label: Cleared the pass mark
